title: Design Studio Selections: Package Allowance and Design Credit Limits by Package
content:
Design credit on a Design Studio Selections file comes from the package allowance, from published promotions and from builder goodwill. The package sets the allowance amount, whether the allowance reaches structural, electrical and plumbing lines, whether unused credit is forfeited when the file is finalized, the cap on promotional credit and the package's goodwill credit cap.

| Package | Package allowance (USD) | Allowance may be applied to structural, electrical and plumbing lines | Unused credit forfeited when the file is finalized | Promotional credit cap (percent of the option total at the time it is applied) | Goodwill credit cap (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 0.00 | No | Yes | 25 | 250.00 |
| Studio Classic | 1500.00 | No | Yes | 25 | 250.00 |
| Studio Select | 3000.00 | No | Yes | 30 | 500.00 |
| Studio Designer | 6000.00 | Yes | Yes | 30 | 500.00 |
| Studio Signature | 10000.00 | Yes | Yes | 40 | 750.00 |
| Studio Atelier | 20000.00 | Yes | Yes | 50 | 1000.00 |

**Notes on the columns**

- The package allowance is design credit granted by the package when the first design appointment is held.
- Where the allowance may not be applied to structural, electrical and plumbing lines, it reaches finish lines only.
- The promotional credit cap is a percentage of the file's option total as it stands at the moment the promotional credit is applied.
- The goodwill credit cap is a figure in US dollars for the whole file.

*Hypothetical illustration of the promotional cap:* on a Studio Select file whose option total stands at 20000.00 when a promotional credit is applied, the promotional credit applied may not exceed 30 percent of 20000.00, that is 6000.00.
